summary:
Business Process Automation: Successfully automated critical business flows, resulting in a 40% reduction in execution time.
Custom Object Development: Designed and implemented a ‘Project Tracker’ custom object, leading to a 20% reduction in manual data
entry and a 30% improvement in project data accuracy.
Support Workflow Optimization: Implemented ‘Email to Case’ functionality, achieving a 40% reduction in case processing time and a
25% increase in support team productivity.
Sales & Marketing Integration: Integrated marketing automation tools with Salesforce to build a total lead and revenue tracking
system.
Enterprise Administration & Development: Extensive experience in Salesforce administration, Apex development, and data integrity
management for large-scale user bases.
Platform Configuration & Customization: Expert in configuring and managing custom fields, validations, workflows, triggers, objects,
relationships, permissions, dashboards, and reports.

jobs.company: Engineered automated batch jobs for five critical business processes, significantly enhancing system efficiency, scalability
bullets: Engineered automated batch jobs for five critical business processes, significantly enhancing system efficiency, scalability, and responsiveness.
Developed and deployed the custom ‘Project Tracker’ object, resulting in streamlined project data management and improved data accuracy across departments.
Designed and delivered dynamic dashboards and reports for project managers and executives, enabling data-driven decision-making and real-time project visibility.
Optimized case management workflows, minimizing operational errors, eliminating missed cases, and elevating overall customer support performance.
Automated the new user onboarding process, reducing manual effort, accelerating onboarding timelines, and improving resource allocation efficiency.

Designed and led the implementation of a scalable Salesforce Experience Cloud application (SAM Communication Platform) to optimize CSM request management, enhancing collaboration, automating workflows with Apex, Aura, and Flows, and enabling secure guest user access.

Developed and deployed a jurisdiction-based data retention automation system in Salesforce to ensure compliance and protect sensitive information, leveraging Custom Metadata Types, Batch Apex, and Scheduled Jobs.

Engineered and launched a robust Email-to-Case automation solution for the RDD CMT Team, utilizing Apex triggers, custom classes, and response rules to improve case accuracy, auto-responses, and internal process efficiency.

Delivered a tailored Email-to-Case system for the CSOV team, incorporating custom Apex logic, CSOV-specific field layouts, and real- time task assignment to streamline case intake, boost tracking accuracy, and support team productivity.

Built a centralized Vendor Management Repository on Salesforce, creating custom objects, flows, and permission sets to migrate vendor data from legacy systems, manage jurisdictional mapping, and optimize project assignment planning.
Achievements: Achieved a 40% reduction in execution time by converting complex business workflows into scheduled batch jobs.
Enhanced project data accuracy by 30% and reduced manual data entry by 20% through implementation of the ‘Project Tracker’ custom object.
